title: One‑Paragraph Impact Diary & Weekly Ask Template
content:
Purpose: capture a very tight (one paragraph) narrative of impact each week + a short, copy-pasteable manager ask. Use as my memory anchor for performance check-ins and to surface measurable signals quickly.

How I use this:
- Fill the "one-paragraph" at the top of the week (or end of week) — 3–4 sentences that combine problem, action, result + metric if available.
- Underneath, jot 3 evidence bullets (artifact links, numbers, customer or internal feedback).
- Draft a 1–2 line manager ask that I can paste into a standup/DM or the 1:1 agenda.
- Quick risks and mitigation (1 line).

2026-03-08 (week ending) — One‑Paragraph Impact
I reduced new-hire time-to-first-ticket for onboarding by ~30% by consolidating three ambiguous checklist items into a single decision table and running a short ship-it pilot with two SWE hires; pilot feedback showed new hires completed first productive PR in 4.5 days (vs historical 6.5), and the handbook patch got 3 peer approvals. This reduced follow-up hand-holding and saved ~6–8 hours of partner onboarding time across the org this week.

Top evidence (quick links):
- Handbook patch: CONFLUENCE:docs/onboarding-decision-table (updated 2026-03-05)
- Pilot: JIRA:POPS-412 (pilot cohort log + survey results, N=4)
- Slack: #eng-onboarding thread — positive feedback from 2 managers (Amir, Lena) on 3/7

Manager ask (copyable):
Can we block 30m next week to review pilot results and decide whether to adopt the decision table as default across Eng? I want to confirm rollout scope and any adjustments to new-hire checklist owners.

Quick risk and mitigation:
- Risk: small N for pilot (4) — mitigation: broaden pilot to 2 more teams next sprint; add an extra feedback question about clarity.

3-Month Goals (current quarter) — framing in one line each:
- Reduce average time-to-first-PR for SWE hires by 25% vs Q4 2025 baseline.
- Create a repeatable runbook for onboarding experiments (template + A/B log).
- Build a lightweight dashboard of onboarding touchpoints and owner SLAs.

Signals I care about (metrics or proxies):
- Time from account creation -> first merged PR (days)
- Number of onboarding follow-ups per hire (count)
- Qualitative: manager NPS on new hire readiness (1–5)

Evidence inventory (where I pull proofs from):
- Confluence update diff (page id in linked_artifacts)
- JIRA pilot ticket (logs, comments, attachments)
- Slack excerpts (date + thread link)
- Survey csv (attached to JIRA)

Open questions / hypotheses to test next sprint:
- Does consolidating decision points reduce manager hand-holding or just shift confusion to a different owner? (observe hand-off comments on pilot threads)
- Is 1 decision table sufficient across infra/SaaS teams or do we need team-level variants?
- Can we get a small automation to pre-populate part of the table from hiring form answers (product ask -> automation ask)?

Manager prep checklist (for 1:1):
- Paste the one-paragraph impact at top of agenda.
- Bring the 3 evidence links (Confluence, JIRA, Slack).
- Bring 1 concrete ask and preferred outcome (align on decision + timeline).
- Note the main risk and preferred mitigation.

Template for weekly capture (copy/paste into my notes):
- WEEK ENDING (YYYY-MM-DD): [one paragraph impact]
- EVIDENCE: [link 1], [link 2], [link 3]
- MANAGER ASK: [30s-2min ask text]
- RISK & MITIGATION: [one line]
- QUICK NEXT STEPS: [3 things for next week]

Examples (short):
- Example A: Reduced interview loop variability by aligning hiring rubric -> outcome: 18% faster time-to-offer; evidence: JIRA:HIRE-221, Confluence:interview-rubric-change. Manager ask: approve updated rubric to ship org-wide.
- Example B: Run 2 coaching sessions for managers on calibration; outcome: 80% attendance + 4.2/5 avg usefulness. Manager ask: greenlight 1 more slot and sponsor invites to G&A leads.

Micro experiments I want to run (next 6 weeks):
- Experiment: 'Pre-onboard checklist' email sent 3 days before start with decision table + owner contact; measure follow-ups and time-to-first-ticket. (A/B vs control)
- Experiment: manager micro-feedback form at day 7 (1–3 Quick Qs) to capture readiness signal earlier.

Notes to self (voice):
- Keep the one-paragraph punchy — you can always expand in evidence. Managers remember tidy narratives better than lists.
- When asking for time, lead with the desired decision + two options. Makes it easier for them to sign off.
- Log the small wins even if they feel mundane — they stack into the narrative later.

Actions (this sprint):
1) Expand pilot to two additional teams, update JIRA with cohort names (owner: Keira, due 2026-03-15).
2) Draft 30m agenda for manager review and attach diff (owner: Keira, due 2026-03-12).
3) Build quick dashboard mock in Notion + link in Confluence (owner: Keira, due 2026-03-22).

Archive: previous notable items (quick log)
- 2026-02-18: Ran mini-cohort retrospective; main ask -> simplify checklist (led to decision table idea).
- 2026-02-25: First draft decision table reviewed by Amelia; actionable edits captured on page.

Random friction notes (for follow-up):
- Owner ambiguity still shows up in the onboarding checklist (line items 4,6). Need to map to individual role owners and add SLAs.
- Recruiting form doesn't consistently include "expected first week project"; ask TA to add field.

End note: this is intentionally terse — returns better for 1:1 prep. If an item is high-scope, create a separate drive doc with full plan and link it here.
